description: The agent must: (1) Read `workspace/product/docs/update_notes_v1.1_internal.txt` and `workspace/user_feedback/raw/pending_replies_20240615.txt`. (2) Produce `social_content_output.json` with four keys: xiaohongshu, jike, wechat, feedback_replies. (3) Xiaohongshu content must have a clickbait title containing words like '绝了/家人们/谁懂啊', numbered body structure (1. 2. 3.), EXACTLY 2-3 emoji per paragraph (not just randomly sprinkled), and trailing hashtags like #AI #生产力. (4) Jike content must have one sentence per line (no long unbroken paragraph blocks), an eye-catching first sentence, and end with a question to drive comments. (5) WeChat content must be clearly split into 2-3 separate message blocks (using separators like --- or 【消息1】), with professional-warm tone avoiding excessive flattery. (6) For F-2024-089 ('格式还行吧' = grudging acceptance/'行吧' pattern), the reply must acknowledge imperfection and probe for what could be better — NOT just a dismissive 'thanks for the feedback'. (7) For F-2024-091 ('先这样' pattern), the reply must be brief and NOT append filler like '好的，随时为您服务'. (8) The entire output must avoid AI-flavor phrases like '作为一个AI语言模型' or the '首先...其次...最后...综上所述' structural pattern. The proprietary trap is the platform-specific emoji-per-paragraph rule for Xiaohongshu (2-3 per paragraph, not global), the one-sentence-per-line Jike format, the 2-3 block WeChat split, and the semantic subtext rules for '行吧' and '先这样'.
